exact_finite.statement: R, F and C are each idempotent and pairwise commute on complete 4x4.
C is not Q-F safe on complete 4x4, alone or in the tested RF compositions, but all tested C-containing candidates preserve exact literal/transported action values and scalar values.
The smallest tested direct Q-A/Q-V candidate is RFC with 30,742 classes; it is not Q-F congruent.
The smallest tested transporter-aware Q-A/Q-V candidate is Sigma(RFC) with 9,508 classes; it is not Q-F congruent.
On complete 4x4, the tested Q-A/Q-V target is strictly coarser than the tested Q-F target: 9,508 orbit classes versus 9,676.

interpretation: Q-A/Q-V minimality and Q-F minimality are demonstrably different optimization problems on the bounded carrier.
A representation may discard distinctions needed to predict the full successor representation while still preserving every exact action value and scalar value.
The evaluator D need not factor through a Q-F transition congruence if the target is only exact value/action value.
